description: This file defines a React-based context provider component, 'PremiumModalProvider', which manages premium feature modals within the application. It includes hooks to access the modal context, handles subscription status and feature activation, and renders a premium features modal component conditionally.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining the props for the PremiumModalProvider component, including application, featuresController, and children.

methods.name: usePremiumModal
methods.description: Custom hook providing access to the PremiumModal context, throwing an error if accessed outside its provider.
